origin.description: The generalized inverse from the positive singular values.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Singular values at or below tol are dropped.

origin.details: The result is V diag(1/d) U'. If no singular value is positive, the result is a zero matrix with the dimensions swapped.
origin.value: A matrix with the dimensions of the transpose.
